## Summary

Describe the change and the reason for it.

## Validation

List the commands, configs, or benchmark cases used to validate the change.

## Numerical or Performance Impact

Describe any expected impact on solver accuracy, conservation diagnostics,
runtime, memory use, output format, or reproducibility metadata.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to the stated problem.
- [ ] Relevant tests or validation commands were run.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior, commands, or assumptions changed.
- [ ] Generated build output, caches, and local experiment artifacts are not committed.
